title: show --json reports an unreadable completion seal the same as a missing one
outcome: show --json reports an unreadable completion seal the same as a missing one
acceptance: A regression test covers a completed item with an unreadable seal and asserts the error_class

When a completed item's completion seal cannot be bound or read, show --json reports acceptance {provenance: unavailable} with an error_class naming the failure, distinct from the plain {provenance: unavailable} of an item with no seal

completion.summary: A completed item whose seal the run names but cannot be read or bound (missing, malformed or misbound) now shows acceptance {provenance: unavailable, error_class} in show --json, distinct from the plain unavailable of an item with no native seal. Tests cover missing, malformed and misbound seals plus a no-seal negative control. Landed as 4ab86e9 with w-901e99a7d50a and w-553e2d2d85d7 (bundle 7 group A).
